key_highlights: 10-year Treasury yield spikes to 5.10%, highest since 2007, as markets price in two Fed rate hikes amid hot PMIs and oil above $100
Oil jumps ~2% on Iran tensions (president vows 'never surrender'), fuelling inflation fears and bond selloff; stocks and bonds slip in tandem
S&P 500 within striking distance of record despite Dow off 300; tech leadership (Meta $900 PT, Palantir buy signal, AMD $1T) offsets broad weakness
Consumer lending stocks (Upstart, Affirm, SoFi) slide 4%+ as rising rates pressure credit-sensitive sectors
Bitcoin near $86K at 8-month highs; NYSE partners with Blockchain.com for tokenized stocks, signalling crypto mainstreaming
Trump-Xi summit looms; soybeans/corn slump on trade expectations; emerging currencies extend decline on strong USD
US Treasury to buy back up to $6B in longer-dated bonds, a partial offset to the yield surge
Paramount settles Warner merger with California and other states; activist pressure continues on Six Flags

sectors.trend: Strong relative outperformance; Meta PTs hiked to $900 on AI revenue momentum, Palantir flashes buy signal, AMD hits $1T valuation, Renishaw posts record results on AI chip demand. However, SOX index drops after 6-day climb, signalling short-term consolidation.
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle remains intact but valuations are stretched. Selective rotation within tech (software > hardware) is the near-term trade. Cathie Wood's quantum computing buy signals continued thematic investing.

sectors.trend: Divergent: broad financials 'barely budge' while consumer lending (Upstart, Affirm, SoFi) drops 4%+ on rising rate fears. BDC debt investments face credit pressure led by software. Blackstone develops hybrid CLO blending private credit and loans.
sectors.implications: Rising yields compress consumer credit valuations. Shift toward core banking and private credit structures. Monitor delinquency data in software BDCs.

sectors.trend: Oil jumps ~2% back above $100 on Iran geopolitical risk; Trump's UN speech and potential Saudi pipeline fix create volatility. Soybeans/corn slump ahead of Xi visit. Gold lackluster as higher-for-longer rates weigh; silver settles pre-summit.
sectors.implications: Oil above $100 is the primary inflation catalyst driving the bond selloff. Geopolitical premium is embedded but fragile. Ag commodities face China demand uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Disney+ raises prices 6th straight year; McDonald's bets on AI drive-throughs and hand-breaded chicken vs Burger King. Paramount settles Warner merger with states. CNN/Politico/MS NOW sue over Trump media ban.
sectors.implications: Pricing power persists in media/consumer but regulatory and political risk is elevated. AI integration in consumer services is accelerating.

sectors.trend: Bitcoin near $86K at 8-month highs; NYSE taps Blockchain.com for tokenized stocks; Kalshi seeks CFTC approval for margin trading on prediction markets. PayPal-Meta partnership expands digital payments.
sectors.implications: Crypto is transitioning from speculative asset to institutional infrastructure. Regulatory clarity (Kalshi, NYSE) is a positive catalyst.

sectors.trend: EM currencies extend decline on strong USD and hot US data. Singapore core inflation hits 2.2% (2-year high). Eurozone gets German growth boost. Northern Ethiopia conflict erupts. Turkey arrests Tera chairman in funds scandal.
sectors.implications: USD strength is a headwind for EM equities and currencies. Singapore may need policy tightening. Ethiopia and Turkey add geopolitical risk to EM allocation.

key_themes: Bond market stress: 10Y yield at 5.10% (2007 high) driven by hot PMIs, oil >$100, and two-hike Fed pricing
Geopolitical premium: Iran tensions, Trump-Xi summit, Ethiopia conflict, Turkey scandal
AI capex supercycle: Meta, Palantir, AMD, Renishaw, Gates Foundation coalition all signal sustained investment
Consumer credit stress: Rising rates hit Upstart, Affirm, SoFi; BDC software exposure under pressure
Crypto institutionalization: NYSE tokenization, Kalshi margin trading, Bitcoin at 8-month highs
Political risk: Trump media ban litigation, SpaceX financial disclosure, DOJ national security arguments
Commodity volatility: Oil see-sawing on Iran/Saudi pipeline; ag slumping pre-Xi; gold range-bound
Housing bifurcation: Mortgage rates finding room to fall even as Treasury yields spike, creating a spread anomaly

risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration to 2-3Y Treasuries; add TIPS allocation; use inverse bond ETFs (TBT) as tactical hedge. Monitor 10Y yield above 5.25% as escalation trigger.
Hedge energy exposure with oil call options or energy ETF (XLE) overweight. Monitor Iran nuclear talks and Saudi pipeline status. Avoid long-duration equities if oil sustains >$105.
Reduce exposure to consumer lending (UP, AFM, SOFI); favour core banks (JPM, BAC) with stronger balance sheets. Watch BDC software delinquency trends.
Maintain 10-15% allocation to gold and defense (LMT, NOC). Diversify across geographies. Monitor Trump-Xi outcome and media ban litigation for sentiment shocks.
Hedge EM currency exposure with USD forwards. Overweight USD-denominated EM debt. Avoid EM equities in high-inflation markets (Singapore, Turkey).
Take partial profits on extended AI names; rotate into AI-adjacent industrials (Renishaw) and infrastructure (data center debt). Monitor SOX index for trend break.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight AI software and infrastructure over hardware; add Meta, Palantir, and Renishaw on dips
opportunities.rationale: Meta $900 PT, Palantir buy signal, AMD $1T, and Renishaw record results confirm AI capex cycle is multi-year. Software firms beating Alphabet signals leadership rotation within tech.

opportunities.recommendation: Add crypto infrastructure and tokenization plays; consider Bitcoin ETF exposure near $86K
opportunities.rationale: NYSE-Blockchain.com partnership, Kalshi CFTC filing, and 8-month high BTC signal institutional adoption inflection. PayPal-Meta deal expands digital payments TAM.

opportunities.recommendation: Buy energy hedges (XLE, oil calls) as tactical position while Iran risk persists
opportunities.rationale: Oil above $100 with Iran president's hardline stance creates asymmetric upside. Trump's UN speech and Saudi pipeline fix add volatility but not directional resolution.

opportunities.recommendation: Consider Banco Bradesco on insider buying signal; evaluate Brazilian bank valuations
opportunities.rationale: Executive bought 79,782 shares for $1.4M, a strong confidence signal. Brazilian banks trade at discounts to global peers.

opportunities.recommendation: Explore the top-performing ETF up 20% in 2026 for continued momentum
opportunities.rationale: Trend-following signal; if the ETF is in a structural theme (AI, energy transition), further upside is plausible.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shorten bond duration to 2-3Y; add TIPS and inverse bond ETFs (TBT) as yield hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: 10Y at 5.10% (2007 high) with two-hike Fed pricing creates significant duration risk. US $6B buyback is a partial offset but insufficient.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer lending exposure (UP, AFM, SOFI); shift to core banks
defensive_moves.rationale: 4%+ drops in lending stocks on rate fears; BDC software credit pressure rising. Core banks (JPM, BAC) have stronger capital and rate sensitivity.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% gold/defense allocation; hedge EM currency with USD forwards
defensive_moves.rationale: Gold range-bound but geopolitical floor intact (Iran, Ethiopia, Turkey). EM currencies in sustained decline on strong USD.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Take partial profits on extended chip names; SOX down after 6-day climb signals short-term top
defensive_moves.rationale: Six-day rally in SOX followed by drop is a classic exhaustion pattern. Rotate into AI-adjacent industrials and data center debt for lower-beta exposure.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Lock in mortgage rates if refinancing; rates finding room to fall despite Treasury spike
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage rates diverging from Treasury yields suggests MBS supply dynamics; window may be temporary.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. 10Y yield at 5.10% and oil >$100 create a stagflationary pressure on equities. S&P 500 near record but Dow off 300 signals leadership narrowing. Expect volatility around Trump-Xi summit and Iran developments. Chip stocks likely to consolidate after 6-day run. Consumer credit names under pressure. Crypto at 8-month highs may see profit-taking. US $6B Treasury buyback provides a floor but is insufficient to offset two-hike Fed pricing.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle (Meta, Palantir, AMD, Renishaw) supports multi-year tech outperformance. Crypto institutionalization (NYSE tokenization, Kalshi) is a structural tailwind. However, sustained 5%+ yields will compress duration-sensitive valuations and pressure consumer credit. Housing market bifurcation (falling mortgage rates vs. rising Treasury yields) suggests policy divergence. Women inheriting $124T wealth transfer is a 5-10 year demographic tailwind for financial planning and advisory services.
